b: We have a teaser trailer and a first look at The Nightingale adaptation. Sony Pictures released the trailer and gave us a first look through Vanity Fair late last week. Information about this highly anticipated adaptation of Kristin Hannah’s bestseller has been trickling out.
Here’s what you need to know about the film, so far:
The film and the book focuses on women’s resistance and mobilization against the Nazis during WWII
Real-life sisters Dakota and Elle Fanning will play sisters on screen for the first time
The film is produced by Reese Witherspoon and her production company, Hello Sunshine, as well as the Fanning sisters’ production company, Lewellen Pictures
The book was a 2023 Reese’s Book Club selection
Reese’s Book Club and Lewellen Pictures shared a first look at the film tie-in cover
The film’s director, Michael Morris, recently worked on another adaptation: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy, the fourth film in the series, based on Helen Fielding’s novel of the same name
The teaser, just under three minutes, emphasizes the progression of the sisters from first-hand witnesses to the war to members of the resistance
On filming a scene together and playing sisters for the first time, Dakota Fanning told Vanity Fair,
We played together our entire lives and acted out scenarios, so it felt like clicking back into that. Like, ‘Oh, of course, this is what we do.’”
Hannah revealed to the publication that she’s unlikely to ever adapt one of her books for the screen.
“I would be afraid that my love for the story that I had written would in some way limit me from being able to see what the film really needed to be.”

You probably know someone who has read Hannah’s bestseller. That says it all about the popularity of her historical fiction set in Nazi-occupied France, and gives us big reason to believe the film will be an epic success.
